label: DNAJB1::PRKACA

sections.text: DNAJB1 encodes an HSP40-family cochaperone that regulates HSP70 activity.
PRKACA encodes the alpha catalytic subunit of cyclic-AMP-dependent protein kinase A.

A chromosome 19 deletion joins the DNAJB1 J-domain region to the PRKACA catalytic subunit, altering PKA signaling and protein interactions. The fusion is characteristic of fibrolamellar carcinoma and is sufficient to induce fibrolamellar-like liver tumors in engineered mice.
